incidents.title: High CPU utilization and OOM kill risk on checkout-api
incidents.description: Container memory exceeding 92% of limit on multiple checkout-api worker pods.
incidents.rootCause: Unbounded caching of raw request payloads in heap memory under peak load.
incidents.resolution: Applied patch limiting payload cache window to 60 seconds and deployed hotfix.

incidents.title: Elevated latency on checkout-api cache cluster
incidents.description: p99 latency elevated to 450ms across checkout-api endpoints.
incidents.rootCause: Cache key hot-spotting on global configuration keys.
incidents.resolution: Added local near-cache for static configuration and flushed stale Redis keys.

incidents.title: Elevated latency on checkout-api cache cluster
incidents.description: p99 latency elevated to 450ms across checkout-api endpoints.
incidents.rootCause: Cache key hot-spotting on global configuration keys.
incidents.resolution: Added local near-cache for static configuration and flushed stale Redis keys.

incidents.title: Database connection pool exhaustion on notification-service
incidents.description: High connection latency detected on notification-service DB instances. Pool utilization reached 100%.
incidents.rootCause: Long-running report queries holding table exclusive lock preventing worker transactions.
incidents.resolution: Terminated blocking queries with pg_terminate_backend and increased connection pool size.

incidents.title: High CPU utilization and OOM kill risk on payment-gateway
incidents.description: Container memory exceeding 92% of limit on multiple payment-gateway worker pods.
incidents.rootCause: Unbounded caching of raw request payloads in heap memory under peak load.

incidents.title: TLS handshake failure connecting to external provider in checkout-api
incidents.description: Downstream HTTP 502/504 errors on checkout-api during payment authorization.
incidents.rootCause: Upstream partner rotated intermediate CA certificate without prior notice.
incidents.resolution: Imported new partner certificate into Java truststore and performed rolling restart.
